Multiple IPOs See Subscription, Allotment, and Listing Activity

Several Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) have seen activity, including subscription periods, allotment finalizations, and market debuts. Turtlemint Fintech Solutions listed on June 29, 2026, at an 11% discount on both NSE and BSE. CSM Technologies IPO, which opened on June 24, 2026, and closed on June 29, 2026, raised ₹20 crore from anchor investors. IPOs for Aastha Spintex, Knack Packaging, Waterways Leisure Tourism, Shreedhar Spinners, and Riyaasat Lifestyle have also been in focus for subscription, allotment, or grey market premium (GMP) indications.
